### Handoff checks

- [ ] I inspected the public diff/history and attachments for secrets, real personal data and unrelated files.
- [ ] All intended app source, tests, README and adapter are committed in the declared directory.
- [ ] The pushed branch matches the frozen SHA above; no further pushes will replace it.
- [ ] Builder evidence is a separate sidecar delivered by 22:00, bound to that source identity.
- [ ] Facilitators can retrieve the source and open every evidence item.
- [ ] I understand this PR is a review record, not a request to merge a team solution into main.

Follow [the submission workflow](https://github.com/proffesor-for-testing/atd-2026-completion-theater-hackathon/blob/main/docs/08-Submission-Workflow.md). Later audit receipts belong in a new comment/attachment, not a new source commit. Only the facilitator-recorded baseline is scored.
